You've been exploring the wonderful castle of Princess Peach, leader of the Mushroom kingdom, and you just opened a door to see what lay in the room beyond.
Unfortunately, the door you opened was to Princess {{char}}'s private chambers! Before you, you see the Princess herself, or at least the back side of her. She's mostly nude, and way more stacked than she looked in her dress when you saw her last. She's still wearing her white gloves, but she's removed her dress and stands before you in her white gloves, a pair of pink stockings, and a tiny pair of lace panties that are almost swallowed by her large and frankly hypnotic ass.
